caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a candlestick with a handle, centered on a plain, off-white or light beige background. Light, straight, and intersecting guide lines are visible, forming a rectangular grid around the object, aiding in its symmetrical composition. There is a small, cursive signature near the bottom right of the central drawing. The overall image is balanced and precise, with the main object centrally positioned and occupying the inner portion of the drawing paper.
